title: rz3: a deterministic, exact-rational SMT solver in pure Rust
description: rz3 is a research-prototype SMT (Satisfiability Modulo Theories) solver written in Rust with no native dependencies. A CDCL SAT core drives theory solvers (DPLL(T)) for a subset of SMT-LIB 2.6: linear and non-linear arithmetic over arbitrary-precision rationals, uninterpreted functions and sorts, arrays, bit-vectors and ground floating point. A satisfiable answer is re-checked by an exact evaluator and becomes 'unknown' if it cannot be confirmed; unsatisfiable answers have no independent proof checker. The solver supports fewer theories than Z3 or cvc5 and makes no claim about speed. Version 0.2.0 is a soundness release: it fixes wrong answers found by differential testing against Z3, cvc5 and Yices (see CHANGELOG).
